params.description: Parameters naming a path in a project.
params.title: PathParams

Gap.description: A stretch of time without history.

content.description:
Whether the point keeps a version of the file. True: `history.content`, `diff.sides` (`base: {point}`) and
`history.restore` give its text (`too-large` above `limits.maxTextBytes`). False: they answer `not-found` —
a moment the companion noted without a text (`Before create`, `Deleted while away`, a write's `Before …`
of a binary file or of one above the text limit) or a commit that does not hold the file (the commit that
deleted it). Both while the path stays as it was (a symlink there serves no point). Companions older than
this field do not send it.

label.description:
The server's `External change`, `Saved`, `Deleted`; the companion's `Before save`, `Before edit`,
`Before restore`, `Before rollback`, `Before rename`, `Before delete`, `Before create`, `Uncommitted when
added`, `Uncommitted when made writable`, `Changed while away`, `Deleted while away`, `External change`; a
commit's summary.

point.description: Opaque to the extension; pass it to `history.content`, `diff.sides` or `history.restore`.

oneOf.description:
The companion's own copies: before each write from the page, the baseline, the reconciliation after a stop,
the top-up beyond the server's limits.
A commit that changed the file.

gaps.description: Stretches of time in which the companion did not watch the project (the history may miss changes there).

summary: The history points of one file (regular, inside the project, or gone): the server's, the companion's copies, commits; and the gaps.
